fact: On 27 August 2026 the National Statistics Council took up the unified V Population and Housing Census and I Agricultural Census, recommending an updated census cartography, a formal calendar and a state contribution of at least 40% of the budget.
title: El Consejo Nacional de Estadística impulsa en su 8ª sesión la ENDE 2027-2031 y el V Censo de Población y el 1º Agropecuario
